name: airc/bridge
description: Ingest one AIRC message into Continuum. Normal messages become chat; explicit !continuum directives become bounded development and test commands. This is the inbox-side companion to airc/send: it lets AIRC peers drive Continuum validation without shelling through jtag chat/send or chat/export by hand.

params.name: message
params.description: Raw AIRC message body. Plain text is bridged into Continuum chat; messages beginning with the command prefix are parsed as bridge directives.

params.name: senderNick
params.description: AIRC sender nick used for attribution in bridged chat text.

params.name: channel
params.description: AIRC channel name, with or without leading #. Defaults to general.

params.name: room
params.description: Continuum room name to target. Defaults to general; the AIRC channel is preserved separately for attribution and mirroring.

params.name: commandPrefix
params.description: Directive prefix for test and control messages. Defaults to !continuum.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: Parse and report intent without executing Continuum commands.

params.name: mirrorResponse
params.description: Send bridge command responses back to AIRC via the airc CLI.

results.name: handled
results.description: True when the bridge executed the parsed action. Dry runs return handled=false.

results.name: parsed
results.description: Structured parser output for the incoming AIRC message.

results.name: responseText
results.description: Short human and AI readable response for the action.

results.name: mirrored
results.description: True when response mirroring to AIRC was requested and handed off successfully.

results.name: mirrorError
results.description: AIRC mirror failure, surfaced loudly instead of swallowed.

results.name: commandResult
results.description: Underlying Continuum command result for directives such as chat export or activity list.
